text:
Sad, beautiful Borinquen moaned

dragging miserable poverty,

she who contained the gift of perennial wealth

in her fertile fields.

Heaven, which lovingly loved her,

could not consent in its tenderness

that she should suffer such barbarous harshness,

she who did not deserve the yoke of evil;

It heard Power's high prayer

(grateful sigh of patriotic love)

and ordered that, to change the precarious era

into rich well-being, Ramiro should go...

Benefactor Ramiro, your noble history

Puerto Rico will engrave in its memory.

translation.title: To the Worthy and Wise Intendant Don Alejandro Ramírez
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the civic sonnet's personified Borinquen and its praise of Ramírez.
